radius.$description: Default (non-pill) corner radius. Pill shape uses {radius.full}.

font-size.$description: Label type size for md; sm reduces to 11px.

gap.$description: Gap between leading dot and label.

min-size.$description: Minimum block size (height) of the badge box; sm uses 18px.

dot-size.$description: Leading status dot diameter; sm uses 5px.

dot-color.$description: Status-dot fill on filled variant (defaults to currentColor).
